description: Free. Creates a Stripe Checkout link for your human owner to pay by card: a credit pack: plan "starter" ($5 for 1,000 calls, default), "builder" ($25 for 6,000) or "scale" ($100 for 30,000). Send pay_url to your owner, then call check_owner_payment with claim_token until status is "paid"; the key is returned once.
name: request_owner_payment
